market.domesticSlice: Servo press segment is the fastest-growing press-type segment going forward (India-specific servo-press growth cited at 6.1%/yr), driven by energy efficiency, programmable stroke profiles and higher repeatability, gradually challenging mechanical/hydraulic press dominance.

structureFacts: Automotive and appliance stamping demand is the primary structural driver cited for the metal-stamping/mechanical-press market in India

Transition toward servo-electric press technology is a well-documented industry-wide structural shift, though mechanical presses remain dominant for high-volume, simple-shape stamping due to lower cost

adoptionStructure.note: Cost-effectiveness for straightforward, uniform-shape components is why buyers choose mechanical presses over servo/hydraulic alternatives, especially for lean, high-volume manufacturing. Buyers evaluating servo presses prioritize energy efficiency, programmable stroke control, and repeatability, particularly in automotive/EV component demand contexts.
